h1: HOP INN Rangsit — a budget hotel you can walk to Future Park from, at a genuinely light price
intro: If your Rangsit trip is about shopping at Future Park, running errands around Thanyaburi, or an overnight before flying out of Don Mueang — and you don't want to overpay — HOP INN Rangsit is the name budget travellers bring up most in this area. It's a 2-star budget hotel by HOP INN that keeps the pitch simple and honest: clean rooms, a comfy bed and good air-con in a building you can walk to Future Park from in under 10 minutes. There are 79 rooms in double and twin layouts, each with a fridge, work desk, private bathroom and free Wi-Fi, plus free parking and free morning coffee. In exchange for a from-price of around ฿650/night, there's no pool, no breakfast, and none of the little extras like a toothbrush or hairdryer — but if the brief is a clean sleep near the mall for cheap, this place delivers.

body.html: Rangsit is where a big chunk of greater Bangkok's northern suburbs actually live — a cluster of big malls, universities and the route up to Don Mueang. HOP INN Rangsit's main selling point is that you can walk to Future Park Rangsit in under 10 minutes, with Major Cineplex Rangsit, Zeer and Big C all close by. That means meals, snacks to bring back to the room, a cinema and everyday essentials are all within walking distance of the hotel. For anyone here to shop, handle business around Thanyaburi, or overnight before a flight, that's the main reason they pick this place despite it being a budget property.

The building is a standard HOP INN block with 79 rooms in two main types — Standard Double with one large bed and Standard Twin with two single beds, around 19.6 sqm each. The rooms are plain but cover the essentials: air-con, fridge, work desk, TV and a private bathroom with hot water. Most reviews praise how clean they are, how they feel roomier than expected for the price, and how comfy the bed is — cleanliness scores on the booking platforms sit in the high 9s, which is very strong for a 2-star.
"Clean, more spacious than expected, comfortable bed, friendly and polite staff. Easy walk to Future Park and plenty of food nearby — great value for this kind of hotel."

On the service side, HOP INN keeps things light and to the point in true budget fashion. You get a 24-hour front desk, a lift, free private parking, free Wi-Fi throughout and free morning coffee. But it's worth knowing up front that there's no swimming pool, no fitness room, no breakfast and no airport shuttle. In-room amenities are basic too — items like a toothbrush, toothpaste, hairdryer or paper cups aren't provided, so pack your own. It suits travellers who use the room mainly to sleep, shower and head back out, rather than anyone wanting to hang around the hotel all day.

The location is on Phahonyothin Road in Tambon Prachathipat, Thanyaburi district, near Future Park Rangsit. It's about 10 km from Don Mueang International Airport, roughly a 15–20 minute drive, and close to the SRT Red Line Rangsit station for easier links into town. Around it you'll find Rangsit Market, Si Mum Mueang Market, the National Science Museum and Dream World within a short drive. It works well as a base for errands around the Rangsit-Thanyaburi area, or as an overnight before or after a Don Mueang flight.

On scores, HOP INN Rangsit punches well above its price. The blended real-review average sits around 8.7 out of 10 — Booking.com rates its location as high as ~9.1 from over 460 reviews, and Trip.com gives it around 9.2 with cleanliness up at 9.6. The repeated praise is for clean rooms, a comfortable bed, the easy walk to the mall, friendly staff and value. The common gripes: noisy air-con in some rooms, a bit of traffic noise since the building sits on a main road, and the fact the hotel doesn't accept children — something families with young kids need to check before booking.

Honestly, HOP INN Rangsit sells simplicity and value, not luxury or facilities. Its strength is a clean, reasonably quiet sleep within walking distance of Future Park, starting in the low hundreds of baht — which is hard to find in this area. If your trip is shopping, errands around Thanyaburi, solo or couple travel on a budget, or a transit night before Don Mueang, this place fits nicely. But if you want a pool, breakfast, or you're travelling with young children, look at 3–4 star options in the same Rangsit area instead.

A tip from reading a lot of reviews here: pack your own toiletries, including a toothbrush and hairdryer, since the hotel doesn't provide them. If you sleep lightly, ask for a room away from the main-road side at check-in to cut the traffic noise, and bring earplugs just in case. Travel as adults only — the hotel doesn't accept children — and confirm that condition before booking if you're a family. Finally, compare a few platforms before you book: standard rooms start in the low hundreds, but on long weekends or when there's a big event around Rangsit, prices climb and rooms fill fast.

faq.q: Where is HOP INN Rangsit and how do I get there?
faq.a: It's at 92 Phahonyothin Road, Tambon Prachathipat, Thanyaburi district, Pathum Thani, in the Rangsit area. You can walk to Future Park Rangsit in under 10 minutes, with Major Cineplex, Zeer and Big C nearby. It's about 10 km from Don Mueang International Airport, a 15–20 minute drive, and close to the SRT Red Line Rangsit station. Free private parking is available.

faq.q: How much does HOP INN Rangsit cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Standard rooms start from around ฿650/night in regular periods. There are two main types — Standard Double with one large bed and Standard Twin with two single beds, each about 19.6 sqm. The hotel has 79 rooms in total. Prices vary by date and holidays; on long weekends or during big Rangsit events rooms fill fast and prices climb, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does HOP INN Rangsit have breakfast or a swimming pool?
faq.a: No — there's neither breakfast nor a swimming pool. This is a budget hotel focused on clean, cheap rooms, with only free morning coffee. In-room amenities are basic, and items like a toothbrush, toothpaste and hairdryer aren't provided, so pack your own. For meals, Future Park is an easy walk away.

faq.q: Does HOP INN Rangsit accept children, and who is it best for?
faq.a: The hotel states it does not accept children and has no extra beds or cribs, so families with young kids should check the terms before booking. It's best for solo or couple travellers on a budget, Future Park shoppers, people with errands around Rangsit-Thanyaburi, and transit overnights before or after a Don Mueang flight. If you want a pool, breakfast or are travelling as a family, look at 3–4 star options in the same area instead.
